name: Find by GUID
description: Reads a column of GUIDs from a worksheet, selects the matching items and lists the GUIDs that matched nothing.

notes.text: WHAT IT DOES: reads the GUID column, finds every item with one of those GUIDs in a single pass, selects them in Navisworks and lists the GUIDs that matched no item. TO CHANGE: the file path and the column name.
